BEH10b_PositiveControl.name: Delayed Discovery Positive Control (Unmutated)
BEH10b_PositiveControl.evidence: 1500ms server delay on 'Sài Gòn' query with NO UI mutation. Completed normally: plannedStatusCode 200, responseFinished true, deliveredStatusCode 200, deliveryOutcome 'DeliveredToClient'. Rendered 1 option 'Khách sạn Sài Gòn Central' at t=2114ms.

BEH10b_RaceClear.name: Delayed In-Flight Discovery Race & Client Transport Abort
BEH10b_RaceClear.evidence: 2500ms server delay on 'Sài Gòn' query. User clicked Clear (×) at t=420ms while in-flight. Angular HttpClient actively aborted connection (res.on('close') with !res.writableFinished, prematureConnectionClosure true, deliveredStatusCode null). DOM at horizon t=3634ms confirms input empty, 0 options, zero resurrection.

BEH06b_QuotePositiveControl.name: Delayed Quote Calculation Positive Control (Unmutated)
BEH06b_QuotePositiveControl.evidence: 1500ms quote delay with NO UI mutation. Safely consumed POST request body before introducing delay (requestCompletedAt recorded). Completed normally with deliveredStatusCode 200. Official quote rendered in #quoteSection (Deluxe Double Room 2 đêm, 2.400.000 đ) at t=2113ms.

BEH06b_Scenario1_DateEdit.name: Date Edit During In-Flight Quote Calculation
BEH06b_Scenario1_DateEdit.evidence: 2500ms quote delay. Request body safely consumed. User modified checkOutDate to '2026-10-25' at t=404ms. HttpClient aborted connection (prematureConnectionClosure true, deliveredStatusCode null). DOM at t=3621ms confirms #quoteSection unmounted, selection reset, no stale quote displayed.

BEH06b_Scenario2_RentalModeSwitch.name: Rental Mode Switch During In-Flight Quote Calculation
BEH06b_Scenario2_RentalModeSwitch.evidence: 2500ms quote delay. Request body safely consumed. User clicked 'Theo giờ' at t=410ms. HttpClient aborted connection (prematureConnectionClosure true, deliveredStatusCode null). DOM at t=3614ms confirms activeMode 'Theo giờ', #quoteSection unmounted, zero stale quote displayed.

BEH11.name: Fixture HTTP Error & In-Browser Retry Recovery
BEH11.evidence: Two distinct recovery outcomes verified in network audit: (1) Nonempty recovery on 'Sài Gòn' query (Reqs 27/28): initial 500 DeliveredError, retry 200 DeliveredToClient, recovered prop-001 'Khách sạn Sài Gòn Central'; (2) Empty-result recovery on 'Hà Nội' query (Reqs 23/24): initial 500 DeliveredError, retry 200 DeliveredToClient with 0 items. In both cases, inline role=alert was cleared upon retry.

BEH09.name: Rendered Keyboard Navigation & Focus-Visible Styling
BEH09.evidence: Full keyboard focus cycle verified with CDP press_key and DOM assertions: ArrowDown moved active descendant to suggestion-0 (opt0Selected true, bg-indigo-50 active classes), second ArrowDown to suggestion-1 (opt1Selected true), ArrowUp back to suggestion-0, Enter accepted selection, Escape closed dropdown (aria-expanded false). Tab navigation verified: pressing Tab from combobox input moved activeElement to adjacent clear button (aria-label 'Xóa từ khóa tìm kiếm'), second Tab moved to date input #hourlyDateInput, and Shift+Tab returned focus in reverse. Measured 2px ring focus-visible and 54px touch target height (exceeds WCAG 2.5.5 enhanced 44px recommendation and WCAG 2.5.8 24px minimum).

limitations: No-DB Execution: All tests run 100% in-memory with synthetic fixtures. No dev/staging/prod/ambient PostgreSQL connections were initialized.
Outbound isolation limitation: Inbound server logs confirm 34 loopback requests from 127.0.0.1, but inbound server logging alone cannot prove complete OS/browser outbound network isolation.
External fonts / cache: Inter font requests may occur if cached or unintercepted.

No Screen-Reader / Overall WCAG claims: Accessibility verified strictly at DOM attributes (role, aria-expanded, aria-activedescendant, aria-selected), focus-visible computed styles, touch target dimensions, and keyboard event/Tab focus levels.
